Kuro.tv 1.5.5-beta6 (versionCode 102)
======================================
Channel: Beta (Google Drive `Kuro` folder `1_lRTGIyahN-fABGstO6t4srd6TkJ0DOb` — `main` and GitHub Release `v1.5.4` untouched)
Signer : CN=Kuro Anime (SHA-256: 1d37c3ca28ed80cc484601a7a7907d5c43970a5d57d51aa4e91475a60703e93e)

Changes in 1.5.5-beta6:
1. Full App Scrolling Restored:
   - Removed the `html:not(...), html:not(...) body { overflow-y: auto; }` override in `beta-ui-1.5.4.css` that interacted with `smooth-ui.css`'s `body { overscroll-behavior-y: contain; }` to trap vertical scroll gestures on `body` and block viewport scroll chaining across Home and all WebView pages.
   - Kept `route-state538.js` and `setupHomeEntryScrollGuard155()` so Home opens cleanly at `scrollY = 0` on app launch without locking touch/wheel/D-pad scrolling.
2. System Default Resolution Restored:
   - Reverted hardware display mode (`preferredDisplayModeId`), mobile `<meta name="viewport">` (`width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover`), WebView `UseWideViewPort`/`LoadWithOverviewMode` (enabled only in Desktop Left-Rail mode), ExoPlayer track selection, and HLS/shader sizing back to native system default resolution.
3. Forced 500 DPI Kept Unchanged:
   - `KuroDisplay155` continues enforcing `Configuration.densityDpi = 500` (`density = 3.125f`) across `MainActivity`, `KuroOfflineActivity561`, `KuroDialogs581`, and post-`new WebView(...)` hooks.
